title: Shared value types (master schema v2.1)
description: Value shapes every type schema reuses, so money, quantities, contact methods and translations look the same in every app. Reference with {"$ref": "../common.schema.json#/$defs/<name>"}.

money.title: Money
money.description: An amount in one ISO 4217 currency. Use `amount_minor` (integer minor units, e.g. cents) for ordinary prices and totals. Use `amount` (exact decimal string) when the value has more precision than the currency's minor unit, such as component prices of $0.0034 each or FX-converted costs. Never use floats. When both are present they must agree.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD, EUR.

amount.description: Exact decimal in major units, e.g. "0.0034".

money_range.description: A range of money in one currency, e.g. a salary band. Amounts in minor units (cents).
money_range.title: Money range

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for both ends of the range.

min_minor.description: Low end in minor units (cents for USD).

max_minor.description: High end in minor units (cents for USD).

period.description: Recurrence period of an amount (salary per year, rent per month).

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: A measured amount. `unit` is a UCUM code (mm, kg, Cel, h, [in_i]) or a UN/ECE Recommendation 20 code (EA, BX, FT) for trade units. Store as received; convert at display time.

unit.description: Unit of measure, UCUM-style where possible, e.g. mm, kg, V, A, degC.

min.description: Lowest value when the quantity is a range (e.g. operating temperature).

max.description: Highest value when the quantity is a range.

tol.description: Symmetric tolerance in the same unit.

contact_point.title: Contact point
contact_point.description: One way to reach someone or something. A list of these replaces one-phone-one-email fields, so mobile, fax, second email, social handles and messaging apps need no schema change.

kind.description: Channel: email, phone, mobile, fax, sms, website, social, radio, other.

value.description: The address or number itself, as written.

label.description: Which one it is, e.g. work, home, after hours, dispatch.

primary.description: True for the preferred contact point of this kind.

valid_to.description: Last date this contact point worked (kept for history instead of deleting it).

contact_points.description: All the ways to reach a person, organization or place: one entry per email, phone or other channel, with one primary per kind.

translations.title: Translations
translations.description: Display text in other languages, keyed by BCP 47 tag. The envelope `label`/`summary` stay in the record's own `lang`.
